title: Add Resend OTP Feature with Timer and Attempt Limit to Login Page

requirements.text: After clicking 'Send OTP' button, display a 'Resend OTP' button/link below the 6-digit OTP input fields with pearl blue text color (#7FB3D5). Initially disable the button for 60 seconds with a countdown timer showing 'Resend in 60s', 'Resend in 59s', etc., counting down to 'Resend OTP' when the timer ends.

quotes: After clicking 'Send OTP' button: Show 6-digit OTP input fields. Add 'Resend OTP' text/button/link below OTP input (pearl blue text, gold hover/glow). Initially disabled for 60 seconds. Show countdown timer next to it: 'Resend in 60s' → 'Resend in 59s' → ... → 'Resend OTP' when timer ends.

acceptanceCriteria: After 'Send OTP' is clicked, 6-digit OTP input fields are displayed
'Resend OTP' button appears below OTP input fields
Button displays pearl blue text (#7FB3D5)
Button is disabled for 60 seconds with countdown timer visible
Timer text shows 'Resend in Xs' format, counting down from 60 to 0
When timer reaches 0, button text changes to 'Resend OTP' and button becomes enabled

requirements.text: When the 60-second timer expires and the user clicks the enabled 'Resend OTP' button, send a new OTP to the same mobile number and reset the countdown timer to 60 seconds again.

quotes: Timer ends pe button enable ho, click pe new OTP send ho (same mobile number pe). Each resend reset timer to 60 seconds again.

acceptanceCriteria: When button is enabled and clicked, a new OTP is sent to the same mobile number
Timer resets to 60 seconds and counts down again
Button becomes disabled again during the new countdown period

requirements.text: Style the 'Resend OTP' button with pearl blue text (#7FB3D5), gold underline/glow effect on hover, and subtle pulse animation when enabled. Display timer text in small pearl off-white color (#F5F5F0) with gold accent on the countdown number. Maintain the dark luxury theme with black background and pearl blue/gold accents. Ensure responsive design for mobile devices.

quotes: 'Resend OTP' button: pearl blue text (#7FB3D5), gold underline/glow on hover, subtle pulse when enabled. Timer text: small pearl off-white (#F5F5F0), gold accent on number. Keep dark luxury theme (black bg, pearl blue/gold accents). Responsive, mobile-friendly.

acceptanceCriteria: Button text is pearl blue (#7FB3D5)
Gold underline/glow effect appears on hover when button is enabled
Subtle pulse animation plays when button is enabled
Timer text uses pearl off-white (#F5F5F0)
Countdown number has gold accent color
Design maintains dark luxury theme with black background
UI is responsive and mobile-friendly

requirements.text: Implement a maximum of 3 resend attempts within a 10-minute window using localStorage to track timer state and attempt count. If the user exceeds 3 resends, display the message 'Too many attempts. Try again after 10 minutes' and disable the resend button until the 10-minute window expires.

quotes: Max 3 resends allowed in 10 minutes (if exceeded, show message: 'Too many attempts. Try again after 10 minutes' and disable resend). Use localStorage to track timer and attempt count.

acceptanceCriteria: Maximum of 3 resend attempts allowed within 10 minutes
Attempt count and window start time are stored in localStorage
After 3 attempts, message 'Too many attempts. Try again after 10 minutes' is displayed
Resend button is disabled when attempt limit is reached
After 10-minute window expires, attempt count resets and resend becomes available again

requirements.text: On successful OTP resend, display a toast notification with the message 'New OTP sent!' using gold border and pearl off-white text (#F5F5F0), consistent with the premium dark luxury theme.

quotes: On successful resend: show toast 'New OTP sent!' (gold border, pearl off-white text).

acceptanceCriteria: Toast notification appears after successful OTP resend
Toast message reads 'New OTP sent!'
Toast has gold border
Toast text is pearl off-white (#F5F5F0)
Toast styling matches premium dark luxury theme

requirements.text: Do not modify any existing functionality for Send OTP, OTP verification, Internet Identity integration, or other parts of the login flow. Only add the Resend OTP feature with timer and attempt limit.

quotes: No changes to other parts (Send OTP, OTP verification, Internet Identity, etc.).

acceptanceCriteria: Existing 'Send OTP' functionality remains unchanged
OTP verification logic remains unchanged
Internet Identity integration remains unchanged
No other login flow components are modified

constraints: Do not modify the existing 'Send OTP' button functionality or OTP verification logic
Do not change Internet Identity integration
Maintain the existing dark luxury theme with pearl blue (#7FB3D5) and gold accents
Use only localStorage for tracking timer and attempt count (no backend changes)
Preserve existing mobile responsiveness and UI consistency
nonGoals: Backend modifications for OTP generation or sending
Changes to Internet Identity authentication flow
Changes to dashboard or other pages
